high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from an article or a webpage discussing the concept of "Empathy" in the context of Apple's customer-centric approach. The text at the top reads: Empathy Apple’s first priority has never been what’s trending — it’s what the customer truly needs, even if they can’t articulate it. That’s what Empathy means in the Apple context. It’s not just listening to feedback or conducting user surveys. It’s putting yourself so completely in the shoes of your users that you anticipate their wants before they do. Below the text, there is an advertisement for YouTube Shorts.
